title: Case File: Tom
content: Tom has been very open about his personal beliefs, expressing a strong stance against organized religion. He has been focused on finding employment and has several job interviews scheduled. Tom has mentioned he lacks professional attire for his interviews and is concerned this may affect his chances.

title: Meeting Notes: Tom's Employment Goals
content: Discussed Tom's progress in job searching. He is preparing for interviews at several tech companies. He is in need of a suit and shoes to ensure he makes a good impression. Tom has been practicing interview questions and is feeling confident about his technical skills.
